environment.conditions: Shared development host; main agent performs simulator/build checks concurrently. No CPU isolation, filesystem cache purge, energy/thermal profiling or repeated independent sessions.

warmup_and_sample_policy: Loaded the seeded 1,000-record snapshot before timing. No save warmup or discarded samples; first timed save remains in the raw data. Each save opens its own SQLite connection through the actual adapter.
dataset_definition: Each original has a unique fictional English/Arabic prefix and ASCII padding to exactly 1,024 UTF-8 bytes; no corrections or links. Save samples grow the store from 1,000 to 1,030 records. All five API reopen samples read the final 1,030-record store.
percentile_definition: Nearest-rank p95: sorted sample at ceil(0.95*n), one-based. Median averages the two middle values for an even sample count. Standard deviation is population standard deviation.
